name: manual_845872
claim: Headless agy cannot read files: the shell permission is auto-denied and the run hangs or prints nothing; inline the diff in the prompt, forbid tools, run read-only under a hard timeout. Gemini CLI access ended on 2026-06-18 for free, Google AI Pro and Google AI Ultra individual accounts; enterprise Gemini Code Assist licences and API-key authentication were announced as unaffected (free-tier API-key behaviour was not stated, so verify it before relying on it). Use agy as the direct-binary reviewer for an individual-account setup, and check which account mode a gemini invocation uses before declaring the CLI unavailable.

decisions.notes: Corrects the over-broad Gemini CLI retirement claim to the verified individual-account scope (maintainer announcement, 2026-06-18); original record preserved append-only.
